neighbours.label: a word for bringing something in from somewhere else (imported, imports, porting software); exporting or producing locally stays low
fire: Nearly all the cheese in that shop is imported from Switzerland.
Japan imports most of the wheat it uses for bread.
The team is porting the old desktop app to Linux this year.
Coffee was first imported into Europe by Venetian traders.
The village shop sells imported beer at very high prices.
Our studio finished porting the racing game to the new console.
Many of the plants in the park were imported from Asia.
The island imports almost all of its fuel by ship.
quiet: Nearly all the cheese in that shop is made in Switzerland.
Japan exports most of the cars it builds to America.
The team is redesigning the old desktop app for Linux this year.
Coffee was first brewed in Europe by Venetian traders.
The village shop sells local beer at very low prices.
Our studio finished testing the racing game on the new console.
Many of the plants in the park were grown from seed.
The island produces almost all of its food on small farms.
